title: Pilates sign-ups open
message_text:
🧘 Mat Pilates & Sculpt with Elira Pilates: sign-ups are open!
Start your Saturday with an energizing, beginner-friendly Mat Pilates & Sculpt class, set to a live DJ! 🎧 It's the perfect way to stretch, reset and recharge between hacking sessions.
📅 Saturday, 9:30–10:30 a.m. (please arrive by 9:15 a.m.)
📍 Rm 2210
Mats provided. Just bring comfy athletic clothes and a water bottle!
Spots are limited to 30 people, so sign up now: https://forms.gle/RtQbm2DDKzA3oquC6
More details: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Vhq1uSoW9c4Wu555E-Seryo7ayHuSy29gIuRgD256z0/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.pqhhsv2w67xm
Huge thanks to Elira Pilates (@elirapilates), a family-owned boutique studio right here in London, for bringing this to Hack Western! 💜

title: Buses
message_text:
🚌 Taking the Hack Western bus today? Here are the pickup times:
• Toronto (55 York Street, in front of Tim Hortons): 2:30 p.m.
• Hamilton (McMaster, Wynne Centre): ~4:00 p.m.

If you have any travel questions, message @alexli!

title: Welcome + check-in
message_text:
🏔️ Welcome to Hack Western 13! Check-in opens at 5:00 p.m. in the Grand Hall in the Schmeichel Building. Use the main entrance on the Western Road side, and have your photo ID and check-in QR code ready. Please check in at the Schmeichel Building, not the Ivey Building! 💜
Running late? No worries! Visit the help desk in front of the Grand Hall when you arrive, or message us in #ask-organizers.

title: Link Slack on live site + Sponsor Bay
message_text:
📣 Important: link your Slack on the live site!
Coffee chat and interview requests, plus sponsor judging updates, will be sent to you through Slack. To make sure you don't miss anything, please link your Slack account and email on the live site now: https://www.hackwestern.com/live
Keep your Slack notifications on this weekend so you see updates right away!
🤝 The Sponsor Bay is also open from 5:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. in the SM Atrium. Stop by to meet our sponsors!

title: Dinner, Mr. & Mrs. Bao
message_text: 🥟 Dinner is here! Huge shoutout to Mr. & Mrs. Bao (@mrandmrsbao) for feeding us tonight! Head to the Grand Hall to grab some food before the Opening Ceremony.

title: DoorDash chicken sandwich
message_text:
🍗 Want free food? If you've never had DashPass before, pull up to the DoorDash booth in the SM Atrium starting at 6:00 p.m. and scan the QR code to verify your student ID for a free chicken sandwich!
Have the DoorDash app downloaded for a quicker process!

title: Opening Ceremony
message_text: 🎤 The Opening Ceremony starts at 7:30 p.m. in the Ivey BMO Auditorium! It's in a separate building, so follow our organizers and volunteers over.

title: Hacking begins + help options
message_text:
💻 Hacking has officially begun! You have until 9:00 a.m. Sunday to build something amazing. Good luck, hackers!
Need help?
• Technical help: ask a mentor in #ask-mentors (include what you need and where you are in the building)
• Hardware: borrow components from the Hardware Lab at the Help Desk in front of the Grand Hall
• 3D Printing Lab & Makerspace: opens at 9:30 p.m. for drop-ins in Rm 2247! Make free 3D prints for your project, with organizers there to help.
• General questions: visit the help desk, or post in #ask-organizers

title: Hacking ends + judging info
message_text:
🛑 Hacking has officially ended! Congratulations on making it through the weekend. Take a breather and get ready for judging.
📍 Demo table assignments will be sent out shortly, so keep an eye on Slack!
🏆 Sponsor track shortlists are coming out at 9:45. If your team is selected for sponsor judging, you'll be notified through Slack. Make sure your Slack account and email are linked on the live site: https://www.hackwestern.com/live
Don't forget to return any borrowed hardware to the Help Desk! 🔧

title: Sponsor track judging results
message_text:
🏆 Sponsor track judging results are out! Check Slack to see if your team was selected, and accept your judging spot: https://www.hackwestern.com/live
Sponsor Track Judging runs from 10:00 to 11:30 a.m. If you're selected, head to your room:
• Scotiabank: Rm 2110
• Canada Life: Rm 2230
• QNX: Rm 2235

title: Main Judging
message_text: 🎉 Main Judging starts at 11:30 a.m. in the Grand Hall! Head to your assigned table. Each project will see 3 judges, with 3 minutes to present and 2 minutes of Q&A each time. Show a live demo, no slide decks! Not finished? Demo anyway!
